Analysts expect Tower Semiconductor Ltd. (NASDAQ:TSEM) to report $0.43 EPS on February, 28.They anticipate $0.15 EPS change or 25.86% from last quarter’s $0.58 EPS. TSEM’s profit would be $45.14 million giving it 9.12 P/E if the $0.43 EPS is correct. After having $0.37 EPS previously, Tower Semiconductor Ltd.’s analysts see 16.22% EPS growth. (NASDAQ:TSEM) has declined 53.82% since February 6, 2018 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 53.82% the S&P500. Derwent London plc, through its subsidiaries, engages in the property investment, refurbishment, redevelopment, and operation of properties in central London. The company has market cap of 3.65 billion GBP. The firm rents its properties for office and residential purposes. It has a 12.11 P/E ratio. It qualifies as a real estate investment trust for federal income tax purposes.
Tower Semiconductor Ltd., an independent semiconductor foundry, makes and markets analog intensive mixed-signal semiconductor devices in the United States, Asia, and Europe. The company has market cap of $1.65 billion. The firm provides various customizable process technologies, including silicon-germanium, BiCMOS, mixed-signal/complementary metal oxide semiconductor , radio frequency CMOS, CMOS image sensor, integrated power management, and micro-electro-mechanical systems. It has a 6.53 P/E ratio. It also offers transfer optimization and development process services to integrated device manufacturers and fabless companies.
